summary: Frontend testing of new Dedicated Network page (/services/dedicated-network). All 8 requested feature checks pass: sections render in order (dn-hero, dn-highlights, dn-overview, dn-solutions, dn-coverage, dn-why, dn-industries, dn-start, site-footer); hero title EN/ID correct ('Reliable Connectivity for Business Continuity' / 'Konektivitas Andal untuk Kelangsungan Bisnis'); images /dedicated/hero.png, technician.png, meeting.png load (naturalWidth>0) and solutions.webp is wired as CSS background on dn-solution-card-0..3; image-slot-dn-map and image-slot-dn-noc empty slots render with labels; contact modal pre-selects 'Dedicated Internet' from dn-hero-quote-btn, dn-hero-team-btn, dn-start-quote-btn, dn-start-sales-btn and from header-contact-btn on this route; form submit shows success toast 'Message sent. Our team will reach out shortly.'; desktop services dropdown contains All Services / Broadband Business / Dedicated Network and header-dropdown-services-servicesdedicatednetwork navigates to /services/dedicated-network; dn-breadcrumb-home navigates to /; mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow (sw==cw==390) and mobile-nav-link-broadband + mobile-nav-link-dedicated both exist and navigate; regression: /services/broadband-business renders bb-hero and header-contact-btn still pre-selects 'Broadband Internet'.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar dropdown testid is generated by stripping non-lowercase from the hash: for '/services/dedicated-network' it becomes 'header-dropdown-services-servicesdedicatednetwork' which is brittle (collides if two paths share same letter sequence); consider using an explicit slug.
DnHero HeroImage renders twice (desktop absolute + mobile relative) so /dedicated/hero.png is downloaded twice — minor perf nit, consider conditional render with Tailwind + single .
DN-MAP and DN-NOC empty slots are intentional (per request) — do NOT replace with stock imagery.
Lenis container warning in console ('ensure container has non-static position') is pre-existing, not introduced by this page.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dedicated Network page fully verified on 1920x1080 desktop and 390px mobile. DN-MAP and DN-NOC image slots are deliberately empty until user uploads images. Contact modal uses a native <select> whose value equals the pre-selected service text ('Dedicated Internet' / 'Broadband Internet'). Toast library is sonner (data-sonner-toast).
